_doc: Manual, web-verified corrections for deals whose price-feed-derived premium is wrong. Two failure modes: (1) foreign issuers whose offer is in local currency (EUR/SEK) while the price feed is the USD ADR/ADS — a currency/ratio mismatch; (2) a bad price print in the feed. Each entry restores the company-stated premium and a currency-consistent reference close, with a source. Applied by parse.py after the price-derived metrics are computed. per_share_upfront is left as-is (already the correct local-currency offer).

TXMD.reason: Feed had a bad $0.20 print 4wk pre-announcement; real unaffected close was $2.14 (2022-05-27). Offer $10.00 = 367.3% premium to that close (211.8% to 30-day VWAP).

CALT.reason: Offer SEK 208/ordinary share (SEK 416/ADS); feed compared it to the USD ADS price. Asahi Kasei stated 83% premium to the unaffected SEK 113.6 close (2024-05-27).

MOR.reason: Offer EUR 68/share; feed compared it to the USD ADR price. Novartis stated 89% premium to the unaffected 2024-01-25 close (~EUR 35.98), 94% to 1-month VWAP.

PSTV.reason: USD feed understated the pre-announcement close (~$1.18 vs real ~$2.86). Roche stated 215% premium (upfront $9.00) to the 2024-11-25 close; up to $13.00 incl. CVR.

MEMY.reason: Sub-dime 2008-crash feed: the 4wk-prior basis was an unreliable $0.07 print, inflating the premium to 771%. Roche stated a 319% premium for the $0.61 offer vs the unaffected $0.145 close (2008-11-24); to-unaffected aligned to that verified figure.

ABLX.reason: Offer EUR 45/share; feed compared it to the USD ADR price. Sanofi stated 21.2% premium to the closing price the day before announcement (~EUR 37.13).

TIG.reason: Offer EUR 1.78/ordinary share; feed compared it to the USD ADS price. 82% premium to the EUR 0.98 Brussels close on 2018-01-04.
